verdict.rationale: The README explicitly advertises CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than total VRAM. Community reports independently confirm that splitting models across GPU and CPU lets users run 70B models on a desktop, and that GPU layer offload (N_GPU_LAYERS) is user-controllable. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of offload configuration and tuning, and clearer evidence on hybrid-mode performance, since one report cites only ~2x speedup with a single CPU core in use and an early 40-layer cap.
